title: Brand and navigation foundation
intent: Turn the confirmed brand and navigation contracts into a reversible, testable foundation for the first Verrail product slice.
scope: Deliver B0 brand assets and conflict screening, implement the N0 workspace navigation flag and route protections, and confirm the TargetReadModel implementation contract.
non_goals: App-wide visible Paperclip to Verrail copy replacement
Authoritative Target write model or target mutation APIs
Authentication, telemetry, package, environment variable, database, or API identifier renames
acceptance_criteria: A documented Verrail mark, wordmark, light and dark lockups, favicon, app-icon raster set, and machine-verifiable asset manifest exist.
A dated basic screen records exact-name software, package, repository, domain, and trademark findings without claiming legal clearance.
Current brand surfaces are classified into migrate, preserve, and defer groups for the next implementation batch.
The workspace compatibility record exposes enableVerrailNavigation with a false default through database, shared contract, server service, and UI API layers.
The home, targets, infrastructure, and governance workspace route roots are registered without being mistaken for workspace prefixes.
New plugin manifests cannot claim Verrail navigation roots, and enabling the flag is blocked when an already-installed plugin conflicts.
TargetReadModel has a confirmed data, API, permission, freshness, and compatibility mapping contract that does not create an authoritative Target write model.
Targeted tests, typecheck, build, asset validation, and documentation integrity checks pass, or any gap is explicitly recorded.
